summary: Mercer International Inc.'s German subsidiaries filed an 8-K disclosing a waiver and amendment to their €370.1 million revolving credit facility. The lenders waived the leverage ratio covenant (max 3.50:1.00) for the first three quarters of fiscal 2026 until December 31, 2026. Conditions include: utilization cap of €300 million if leverage >2.00:1.00; minimum $30M average liquidity (13-week rolling); 2026 capex limit of €60M; restricted distributions to parent (up to €15M allowed with conditions); drawdown requests capped at €20M until initial liquidity forecast provided. No advisors named. Watch covenant compliance and liquidity forecasts for risk of further amendments.
